self_checks.driving_principle: Where the eyes point is where the hands steer toward. Looking at the apex instead of through it tends to produce a line that arrives at the apex correctly and has nowhere good to go after it.

self_check.basis: Where the eyes point is where the hands tend to steer toward; there is no eye-tracking channel in the telemetry, so this can never be measured, only self-tested.
self_check.instruction: Say out loud where you're looking the instant you turn in. If you can't answer before you're already at the apex, you're looking too late.
self_check.label: coaching hypothesis, not a measurement — we can't see your eyes

incidents.note: Incidents are single events (N=1): this lap did X, decomposable to the trace. Not a driver trait, and never priced as recoverable time. An 'unclassified' incident is detected but its cause was not clean enough to name — stated, not guessed.

abs_active_ratio.description: Share of braking time with ABS active.

brake_application_rate.description: How fast the pedal rises from first application to peak.

brake_peak.description: Maximum brake pedal reached in the corner.

brake_point_dist_pct.description: Where braking for the corner begins.

brake_release_duration_s.description: Time taken to release the brake: from last near-peak pressure to off.

coast_s.description: Time between brake release and throttle pickup with neither pedal working.

exit_accel_ms2.description: Mean longitudinal acceleration from apex to full throttle.

min_speed_kmh.description: Minimum corner speed at the primary apex.

steering_corrections.description: Steering-rate sign reversals between turn-in and apex beyond the jitter floor.

steering_smoothness_dps2.description: RMS steering acceleration turn-in to apex; lower is smoother.

throttle_brake_overlap_s.description: Time with throttle and brake applied together.

throttle_modulation_count.description: Throttle lifts/stabs between pickup and full throttle.

throttle_pickup_dist_pct.description: Where throttle is first picked up after the corner's final lift.

trail_brake_overlap_s.description: Time spent braking while steering (trail braking).

turn_in_dist_pct.description: Where sustained steering for the corner begins.

yaw_peak_rate.description: Peak yaw rate in the corner (rotation actually achieved).

unavailable_fundamentals: tire slip/utilization — no slip channel in the source; never inferred
vision/eye-line — not measurable from telemetry; never inferred
fuel load, weather, lap validity, stint index — absent from the source contract; controls degrade with stated caveats instead
